/commit reviewer feature {"number":6,"title":"feat: ADW multi-repo support (APP env var)","body":"## Summary

- Adds `app_config` module: `APP` env var → `apps/{APP}/adw.config.json` → resolves target GitHub repo, R2 bucket, and app name
- All GitHub operations routed through `get_effective_repo_path()` — APP config takes precedence over git remote origin
- Worktree creation clones the app repo directly (instead of `git worktree add`) when APP is set, with agentic tooling symlinked in
- Migrates screenshot/file storage from AIO Files to R2 with app-namespaced object keys (`adw/{app}/{adw_id}/...`)
- Pipeline phases (plan, review, test) and cron trigger wired to multi-repo routing
- Dev server lifecycle delegated to app-owned `scripts/start_dev.sh` (PID-file based)
- Shell scripts (`cleanup_worktrees`, `purge_tree`, `clear_issue_comments`) support `APP=x` scoping
- Removes `@adobe/aio-lib-files` JS dependency (no longer needed after R2 migration)
- Review auto-fix scope expanded from blockers-only to blockers + tech_debt

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify `APP=content-qa uv run adws/adw_triggers/trigger_cron.py` resolves `joaquinrivero/experience-qa` and shows `[APP override]` in header
- [ ] Run a full ADW cycle (plan → review → test) with `APP=content-qa` against a labeled issue
- [ ] Confirm worktree is created under `apps/content-qa/trees/` as a standalone clone with `.claude`, `CLAUDE.md`, `adws` symlinked
- [ ] Confirm R2 uploads use `adw/content-qa/{adw_id}/...` object key namespace
- [ ] Run without `APP` set — verify all behavior degrades to agentic-harness-local mode (no regressions)
- [ ] Verify `scripts/purge_tree.sh` correctly detects clone vs worktree and cleans up both"}
